name: 🍕 Pizza Party
tagline: Fresh Whole Foods dough, Rao's, crisp pepperoni and everybody makes their own pie.

items.name: Flour or cornmeal for the pan

steps.text: Take the dough out of the fridge 30–60 minutes before so it stretches easily. Oven to 475°F with a sheet pan inside.
Cut the dough into 4 balls, one per person.
On a floured counter, press and stretch each ball into a thin 8-inch round. Let it rest 5 minutes if it springs back.
Brush the rims with olive oil. Spread 2–3 Tbsp sauce on each, leaving a border.
Top with mozzarella, then pepperoni, then a sprinkle of parmesan and oregano.
Slide onto the hot pan (on parchment is easiest) and bake until the crust is deep golden and the cheese bubbles.
Rest 2 minutes, then cut with a pizza wheel.

kid_jobs.job: Shape your own pizza (it doesn't have to be round)
Spread the sauce with the back of a spoon
Lay out the pepperoni: make a face or your initial

chef_tip: Preheat the pan in the oven. Dough that hits a screaming-hot surface gets a crisp, pizzeria bottom instead of a soft, pale one.
make_ahead: Dough keeps 2 days in the fridge, or freeze it and thaw overnight in the fridge.
leftovers: Reheat slices in a dry skillet with a lid, 3–4 minutes: crisp bottom, melty top. Great cold in a lunchbox too.
swaps: Pizza crust (i276) or naan for a 10-minute version
Hot honey drizzle on the pepperoni for the grown-ups
serve_with: A spring-mix salad with Italian dressing
heads_up: Dough out of the fridge and oven to 475°F 30 min before.
